opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Motion to dismiss on the ground that the cause has become moot denied. Motion to affirm granted upon the ground that the questions on which the decision of the cause depends are so unsubstantial as not to need further argument. Rule 7, par. 4. The judgment is affirmed.
